questions.q: Who does the storyteller say told him this tale?
choices: Limmershin, the Winter Wren
Sea Catch, the old fur seal
Kerick Booterin, the seal-hunter
Sea Vitch, the walrus
questions.evidence: Limmershin, the Winter Wren, told me the tale

questions.q: Why did Sea Catch fight with the other seals every spring?
choices: To win a good place by the sea for his nursery
To become the leader of all the seals on the beach
To drive the young bachelor seals off the island
To get the best fishing grounds near the rocks
questions.evidence: He only wanted room by the sea for his nursery.

questions.q: Which of these was against the Rules of the Beach?
choices: Chasing a beaten seal
Fighting in the breakers
Eating while on the beach
Arriving before the wives
questions.evidence: Sea Catch never chased a beaten seal, for that was against the Rules of the Beach

questions.q: The young seals were called "the holluschickie." What does that word mean?
choices: The bachelors
The babies
The hunters
The mothers
questions.evidence: They were called the holluschickie--the bachelors

questions.q: Why was Sea Catch usually in a bad temper during the summer on the beach?
choices: He ate nothing during the four months he stayed there
His wife Matkah always arrived late and kept him waiting
The holluschickie made too much noise in the sand dunes
The fog hid the sun almost every day of the season
questions.evidence: It was not the fashion for Sea Catch to eat anything during the four months

questions.q: Why did Sea Catch refuse Matkah's idea of moving to Otter Island?
choices: Other seals would say they were afraid
The fishing there was poor and thin
The Killer Whale hunted off its shores
It was much too far from Lukannon
questions.evidence: If we went there they would say we were afraid.

questions.q: What was unusual about Matkah's baby, Kotick?
choices: His coat was going to be white
He was born with a full mane
He could swim on his first day
He had dark brown eyes
questions.evidence: our baby's going to be white!

questions.q: What happened the first time Kotick went down to the sea?
choices: A wave carried him out of his depth and he nearly drowned
He swam out so far that his mother had to bring him back
He met the Killer Whale and raced straight back up the beach
He floated happily on his back until the tide turned again
questions.evidence: if the next wave had not thrown him back again he would have drowned

questions.q: What did Kotick do whenever he saw a thin fin drifting close to shore?
choices: He headed for the beach like an arrow
He dived down deep beneath the waves
He called loudly for his father to come
He hid among the slippery weedy rocks
questions.evidence: Kotick would head for the beach like an arrow

questions.q: According to Matkah, what did tingly, prickly feelings in the skin mean?
choices: Bad weather was coming, so he must swim hard and get away
Fish were close by, so it was a good time to dive for food
Men in boats were near, so he must keep his head down
Spring had come, so it was time to return to the beaches
questions.evidence: tingly, prickly feelings meant bad weather coming

questions.q: Which of these did Matkah teach Kotick to leave alone?
choices: Flying fish, because they are all bony
Cod, because they bite back very hard
Halibut, because they hide in the weeds
Porpoises, because they never share fish
questions.evidence: to leave the flying fish alone because they are all bony

questions.q: What made Kotick suddenly turn north while he was off the Island of Juan Fernandez?
choices: He felt lazy and homesick for the beaches of Novastoshnah
His mother called him home to help with the new babies
A gale was coming and the porpoises told him to flee
He wanted to show his white coat to his old friends
questions.evidence: he remembered the good firm beaches of Novastoshnah

questions.q: The waves broke "in great phosphorescent streaks and swirls." What does "phosphorescent" mean?
choices: Glowing with light in the dark
Foamy and very noisy
Cold and icy gray
Muddy and full of sand
questions.evidence: the waves break in great phosphorescent streaks and swirls

questions.q: Why did Kerick Booterin tell Patalamon not to touch the white seal?
choices: He feared it might be the ghost of old Zaharrof
He wanted to keep the rare white skin for himself
He thought it was too small to be worth skinning
He knew Sea Catch would fight any man who came near
questions.evidence: Perhaps it is old Zaharrof's ghost.

questions.q: Why did the men drive the seals so slowly to the killing-grounds?
choices: If the seals got heated, their fur would come off in patches
Kerick wanted to stop and count every seal along the way
The path was full of rocks that could hurt the men's feet
The seals were tired and would not move any faster for them
questions.evidence: if the seals went too fast Kerick knew that they would get heated

questions.q: What did Kotick do after he saw the men kill and skin the seals?
choices: He galloped back to the sea and flung himself into the water
He hid behind the Salt House until the men had gone home
He ran straight to his mother and told her what he had seen
He tried to warn the other seals on the beach of the danger

questions.q: What did the Sea Lion say seals must find if they never wanted to be driven by men?
choices: An island where no men ever come
A beach far south of the Sticky Water
A cave hidden deep under the sea
A leader strong enough to fight men
questions.evidence: unless you can find an island where no men ever come you will always be driven

questions.q: What is this part of the story mostly about?
choices: A white seal grows up, sees hunters kill seals, and seeks a safer home
A huge old seal fights every other seal to become king of the beach
A seal-hunter and his son try to capture the rare white seal alive
A young seal and a porpoise race each other around the Pacific
